verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Cloudflare's developer docs expose a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) covering the whole docs site including Sandbox, giving agents a structured entry point. However, a probe for the markdown version of the specific Sandbox get-started page returned 404, showing per-page agent-friendly docs aren't uniformly available. Missing for 10: dedicated llms.txt or .md endpoints scoped to the Sandbox product docs, and no community/hands-on confirmation of agents actually consuming it successfully.
